episodes.title: Un cabronazo de la vieja escuela
episodes.summary: An angry war veteran who hates the drug dealers infiltrating his neighborhood sets out to reform his teen granddaughter, who's being led astray by them.

episodes.title: Radios estropeadas
episodes.summary: When Irene comes home beaten, Tirso sets out to get justice. Nelson finds a way to stay near Irene. Tirso's disposal of the heroin brings consequences.

episodes.title: Morder
episodes.summary: Ezequiel is seen holding Nelson at gunpoint. Tirso discovers his granddaughter wasn't just beaten. Pressured by his wife, Santi faces his father.

episodes.title: Lo que se esconde bajo la alfombra
episodes.summary: Sandro cuts ties with Ezequiel, who tries to convince Tirso to join forces with him to take down the drug boss. A psychologist arrives to treat Irene.

episodes.title: Perro viejo no perrea
episodes.summary: Tirso suspects Sandro stores his drug supply at a night club, and enlists Gladys to gain entry. Irene turns to unhealthy ways of coping with her trauma.

episodes.title: Quien roba a un ladrón
episodes.summary: Tirso tests Nelson's capacity for hard work and forces Gladys to face Alicia, whose home she's squatting in. Nata gets a job at La Rosa and makes a find.

episodes.title: Los Robin Hood
episodes.summary: A journalist sets out to unmask the Entrevías Robin Hoods. Alicia gives advice on men to Gladys, who follows it. Ezequiel puts Nata on a risky mission.

episodes.title: El último tren
episodes.summary: Nata sets out to get revenge against Sandro. Tirso learns of Irene's drug use. Sandro's henchman Yeyo follows a hunch to prove who the Robin Hoods are.

episodes.title: Colgar la casaca
episodes.summary: Eager to rule Entrevías' entire drug trade, Nata declares war against a rival gang. Now retired, Tirso appoints himself as an armed street-corner sentry.

episodes.title: Un vagón olvidado
episodes.summary: Jimena's colleague shares his plans for developing Entrevías. Ezequiel discovers Nata's weakness. Irene tells her grandfather she has an aspiration.

episodes.title: Escucha al corazón
episodes.summary: Irene makes a decision about her future. Now out of prison, Yeyo becomes a problem for Tirso and his family. Nelson and Nata rob Pepe at knifepoint.

episodes.title: Salto al vacío
episodes.summary: Amanda finds five other rape cases like Irene's. Pepe lets Gladys work as a cook at his bar. Injured but alive, Ezequiel gets a lead on Santo's killer.

episodes.title: La cruda verdad
episodes.summary: To avoid prison, Nelson agrees to work as a mole to ID the Ghost. Irene accidentally outs her mom. Yeyo offers Tirso info on the rapists — for a price.

episodes.title: Todo por amor
episodes.summary: Jimena chooses between her family and her job. Ezequiel provokes the Ghost in a bid to become Yeyo's replacement. Nata secretly follows Nelson.

episodes.title: Un polo naranja
episodes.summary: Nata's gang opens a trap house near Pepe's bar. Unsure she can trust Nelson anymore, Nata feeds him false intel to see if he passes it on to the police.

episodes.title: Si me matan
episodes.summary: Amanda asks for Jimena's help in gathering evidence against the Ghost. Nata is ordered to kill Tirso, and finds out Nelson is secretly seeing Irene.

episodes.title: Un palo en el avispero
episodes.summary: As Tirso's ex resurfaces and a conniving new cop arrives, Entrevías is sent into turmoil. Irene is rushed to the hospital, and Ezequiel wakes up.

episodes.title: Culpa
episodes.summary: Guilt plagues Tirso as Tente provokes chaos in Entrevías. Romero wants to appear as a savior, but Ezequiel steals the spotlight.

episodes.title: Llanto
episodes.summary: Tirso bids farewell to his family. With a target on his back, Ezequiel tries to stay under the radar. Maica wants to meet her great-grandson.

episodes.title: Machitos violentos
episodes.summary: Tension with Gladys leads Tirso to focus on his family. Ezequiel finds a path to power, but Tente won't let go without a fight.

episodes.title: Segundas oportunidades
episodes.summary: Tirso's assumptions about Maica materialize. A discovery about Tente complicates things for Nelson. Romero carries out a dangerous plan.

episodes.title: Lo que dicta la conciencia
episodes.summary: Gang members regain territory and Tirso is determined to intervene. Amanda's trial looms, while Irene begins secretly planning her future.

episodes.title: Un buen muchacho
episodes.summary: Honesty prevails with Tirso's testimony and someone unexpectedly coming clean… with dire consequences. Romero and Dulce make a pact.

episodes.title: El cielo de Entrevías
episodes.summary: A murder rocks Tirso to his core as a wedding nears. Ezequiel finds damaging evidence and endangers himself — and everyone around him.
